reader_question: Do Republicans and Democrats agree on a ban on stock trading by members of Congress?
grade_line: Documented: a published survey by the University of Maryland’s Program for Public Consultation
title: In a May 2023 survey of 2,625 registered voters, 87 percent of Republicans and 88 percent of Democrats favored a ban on stock trading by members of Congress.
measure_line: Registered voters who favor a ban on stock trading by members of Congress, percent, by party, survey fielded May 19 to 30, 2023, United States.
alt: In a May 2023 survey of 2,625 registered voters, 87 percent of Republicans and 88 percent of Democrats favored a ban on stock trading by members of Congress.
notes_internal: Data plan row 41: the same question as S41, answered in one sourced sentence (coverage plan R01). The drawing is the sentence (labels.sentence, the title word for word; the page receives only a spec's drawing keys) in the title face; show prints the evidence label, the drawing, the source line and the folded table, and leaves out the printed title, measure line and notes, so the sentence appears once. The alt is the sentence, so a screen reader hears it word for word.

source_line: Source: Program for Public Consultation, University of Maryland, survey of 2,625 registered voters, fielded May 19 to 30, 2023, United States, as recorded in Oath & Action’s systems atlas, Who Do They Answer To?, snapshot of October 15, 2026.
